# 烈焰物品的替代創造

[EN] About the mod ## About the mod Alternate Create Of Fiery Items (ACOFI) is an addon for [Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest) that changes the crafting of fiery equipment to be similar to Netherite after the 1.20 update. ## Fiery Upgrade Template The template is used to upgrade iron items to fiery items. It spawns in chests within the Ur-Ghast's Dark Tower.

## Configuration (*For mod version 1.2.0 and above*) Configuration file - `/config/acofi-common.toml` In the config, you can adjust the template spawn chance and which loot tables it will generate in. That is, you can make the template drop from a mob, boss, or any other structure besides the Dark Tower. Example config: ```toml ["ACOFI Config"] #Upgrade template spawn chance. (0.2 = 20%) #Default: 0.2 #Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0 upgrade_template_spawn_chance = 0.65 #List of loot table IDs where the upgrade template will spawn. #Default: ["twilightforest:chests/darktower_cache", "twilightforest:chests/darktower_key"] target_tables = ["minecraft:chests/end_city_treasure", "minecraft:entities/warden"] ```
[TW] 關於此模組 ## 關於此模組 Alternate Create Of Fiery Items (ACOFI) 是一個為 [Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest) 設計的擴充套件，它在 1.20 更新後將火焰裝備的合成方式變得更類似於下界合金。 ## 火焰升級模板 這個模板用於將鐵製物品升級為火焰物品。它會在烏爾蓋斯特黑暗塔的箱子中生成。

## 設定檔配置 *(適用於模組版本 1.2.0 及以上)* 配置文件路徑：`/config/acofi-common.toml` 在配置文件中，您可以調整模板生成的機率以及它所產生的 loot table。也就是說，除了黑暗塔之外，也可以讓這個模板掉落自怪物、頭領或任何其他結構。 示例配置文件： ```toml ["ACOFI Config"] #Upgrade template spawn chance. (0.2 = 20%) #Default: 0.2 #Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0 upgrade_template_spawn_chance = 0.65 #List of loot table IDs where the upgrade template will spawn. #Default: ["twilightforest:chests/darktower_cache", "twilightforest:chests/darktower_key"] target_tables = ["minecraft:chests/end_city_treasure", "minecraft:entities/warden"] ```
